rule.description: Producing-rule slug — e.g. 'axis_180', 'eyeline', 'character_drift', 'environment_drift', 'prop_hallucination', '30_rule', 'costume', 'lighting', 'time_of_day', 'weather', 'screen_direction'. Strings rather than Literal so new rules can be added without a schema bump.
rule.title: Rule

annotation_ids.description: ≥2 annotation ids the violation relates (e.g. the two panels in conflict). Order is meaningful when the rule is directional (e.g. 'character_drift' from A to B).
annotation_ids.title: Annotation Ids

detection_method.description: How the violation was detected — 'face_embed_cosine', 'optical_flow_direction', 'object_detect_set_diff', etc.
detection_method.title: Detection Method

detection_value.description: Numeric detection signal (e.g. cosine distance). None for boolean detections.
detection_value.title: Detection Value

threshold.description: Threshold the value crossed to trigger the violation. None for boolean detections.
threshold.title: Threshold

suggested_fix.description: Human-readable fix sentence; the FE renders it in the continuity panel.
suggested_fix.title: Suggested Fix

suggested_action.description: Coarse action recommendation. Drives which button the FE highlights.
suggested_action.title: Suggested Action

evidence.description: Rule-specific evidence (e.g. eyeline vectors, bbox set diffs). Opaque to lacing; consumed by the inspector.
evidence.title: Evidence
